_note: Woo/DiWoo publication — DECLARATIVE CORE ONLY: renders the two pure-config schemas of fragment 58 (woo-categorie-mapping per-type TOOI informatiecategorie mapping, woo-bestuursorgaan per-body bestuursorgaan id) as the admin-facing configuration surface (REQ-WOO-001 / REQ-WOO-006). Appended onto the bundled src/manifest.json by main.js::mergeManifestFragments (ADR-037). Index + detail pages; schema refs BY SLUG (woo-categorie-mapping / woo-bestuursorgaan), never PascalCase (manifest schema-ref = slug rule). The Woo-index sitemap harvest, the DiWoo payload decoration, the optional OpenConnector LV-Woo push, and the coverage KPI aggregation view are IMPERATIVE services rendered elsewhere and are OUT of this declarative-core scope. Frontend CRUD on both schemas goes through OR's object API via useObjectStore (no pass-through controllers — redundant-controller gate).

config._note: WooCategorieMapping index (REQ-WOO-001). Per-publishable-type default TOOI informatiecategorie mappings. Columns objectType/informatiecategorieLabel/informatiecategorie/active; quick filters on active; index _search matches objectType and informatiecategorieLabel. Sorted by objectType so duplicate type rows are immediately visible (OR has no cross-object unique constraint). Create/edit run through OR's object API via useObjectStore — no pass-through controllers.

WooCategorieMappingDetail (REQ-WOO-001 / REQ-WOO-006). The mapping data (objectType, informatiecategorie TOOI URI + label, active, notes) renders in the data widget; edit runs in a dedicated dialog (modal-isolation gate). Audit trail is a sidebar tab. A mapping whose objectType schema is not installed stays inert — the coverage view (imperative, out of core scope) surfaces it as 'type not installed'.

WooBestuursorgaan index (REQ-WOO-006 admin settings shape). Per-governance-body bestuursorgaan TOOI id override; the instance-wide default lives in app config. Columns governanceBody/bestuursorgaan/label/active; quick filters on active; index _search matches bestuursorgaan and label. Create/edit through OR's object API via useObjectStore — no pass-through controllers.

WooBestuursorgaanDetail (REQ-WOO-006). The per-body bestuursorgaan override (governanceBody reference, bestuursorgaan TOOI id, label, active, notes) renders in the data widget with the linked GovernanceBody as a resolved reference; edit runs in a dedicated dialog (modal-isolation gate). Audit trail is a sidebar tab.
